Need a bio for your conference website? Three sizes, help yourself — also available as [plain text](/bio.txt).

## 🥄 Short version (one spoonful)

> Colin Fay is a lead developer at ThinkR, a French agency focused on everything R-related. He builds R packages, `{shiny}` apps that survive production, and maintains the `golemverse`.

## 🍽️ Long version (full plate)

> Colin Fay is a lead developer at ThinkR, a French agency focused on everything R-related.
>
> By day, he helps companies take full advantage of the power of R. He builds tools, deploys infrastructure, and patiently explains that a `{shiny}` app is a serious piece of software like any other. His playground: data & software engineering, web applications (frontend *and* backend), and the long unglamorous road that takes R code all the way to production.
>
> By night, he is an active open source developer and advocate: main developer of `{golem}` and the wider `golemverse`, lead author of *Engineering Production-Grade Shiny Apps*, and he travels the world to complain about computers in front of an audience.

## 🤘 Unofficial version (for the brave)

> Colin writes R for a living and runs absurdly long distances for fun. He eats only plants, listens to music that sounds like a chainsaw falling down a flight of stairs, and holds strong opinions about putting R in production. Buy him a coffee, and he will tell you about all four, whether you asked or not.
